purpose: Test whether a bounded causal M15 SHORT reclaim/confirmation family can improve the M10F M15 SHORT seed toward PF 2 without changing the frozen loss-filter seed or touching any forward monitor.

reclaim_family.reason: Direction-symmetric counterpart of the already studied M15 LONG reclaim neighborhood; this stage tests entry confirmation only and does not add runner logic.
reclaim_family.atr_source: latest fully closed M15 Wilder ATR14 at original first-turn time
reclaim_family.immediate_entry: if first-turn M1 open <= reclaim level, short at that exact M1 open bid
reclaim_family.delayed_confirmation: otherwise wait only for fully closed M1 close <= reclaim level; enter short at exact next M1 open bid
reclaim_family.timeout: skip if confirmation does not occur within max wait or before native exit
reclaim_family.native_exit: unchanged original native exit at exact M1 open ask using historical spread

evaluation.historical_holdout_note: M10F holdouts have now been inspected. M10G is research-exposed hypothesis development and must not be presented as fresh/OOS validation. Any promising exact rule requires later deterministic reproduction and a new fresh prospective start.
